_comment: Reviewed by a person, not inferred — see docs/organisation-names.md and `python -m pipeline.orgcheck --review`. Each alias group: canonical (the name shown on the organisation page) and variants (every spelling in the register that should map to it). `ignored` records candidates a reviewer looked at and decided were not the same organisation, so orgcheck doesn't keep re-suggesting them — each entry is the sorted list of names in that candidate.
